name: Randomized $k$-Mistake Littlestone Dimension of Trivial Concepts
proof: Filmus--Hanneke--Mehalel--Moran's Theorem 65 gives this exact randomized $k$-mistake bound for two experts. Its proof shows that an optimal tree may have every expert-prediction pair equal to $(0,1)$. This is exactly the tree model for the two complementary constant concepts, so their identity $M^\star(2,k)=\mathrm{RL}^{\mathrm{mist}}_k$ gives the displayed value.
